# Preorder Maintenance: Of Everything, Part One by Stewart Brand

### The first in-depth exploration of maintenance, and an argument for its civilizational importance.

Nov 18, 2025

19

1 4

Share

...

Over a 60-year career, Stewart Brand has invited us to look at everyday life anew. With the _Whole Earth Catalog_ , he presented readers with a more communal, more self-sufficient way of living.

...

Now, with _Maintenance: Of Everything, Part One_ — [available for preorder now](http://press.stripe.com/maintenance-part-one) —he encourages us to see our world through the lens of maintenance and repair. “Maintenance is what keeps everything going,” he writes. “It’s what keeps life going.”

Stewart [began publishing the series](https://books.worksinprogress.co/) via our sister magazine, Works in Progress, in 2023. These chapters are now collected in print, in the first of a planned multi-volume work on the civilizational importance of maintenance.

In it, he invites us to rethink maintenance not as a set of tedious tasks—“brush the damn teeth, change the damn oil”—but as a profound act of responsibility and care.

Part One explores what we can learn from the maintenance of sailboats, motorcycles, cars, and weapons, with detours into the evolution of precision in manufacturing, the enduring importance of manuals, the concept of sustainment in the military, and the never-ending battle against corrosion.
